text_simplified: This text discusses the definition of tarbiyah (Islamic upbringing) from both an Islamic and linguistic perspective, where the word 'tarbiyah' conveys meanings of growth and increase. Tarbiyah means nurturing the child and developing them in all aspects of life, as mentioned in the Qur'an and hadith. There are differences in the technical definitions of tarbiyah according to various intellectual schools.
